title: IronWine Cellars System
description: Webapp System for managing the business process of the IronWine Cellars company.
details:
System made to satisfy the business needs of the company IronWince Cellars. Handling client quotations, orders and data management.
 Designed with Figma. Frontend: React, Bootstrap, TailwindCSS. Backend: Flask, Python OOP. Database: PostgreSQL. Deployment: Ubuntu Cloud Server (Vultr), Containerized with Docker, HTTPS protocol with Nginx.

title: Chat Chinese
description: Chatbot to translate in detail to Chinese.
details: Implemented a chatbot to translate in detail to Chinese with Deepseek API and Firebase for real-time chat. Made with NextJS, Firebase, and TailwindCSS.

title: Mexican Stock Market Prediction
description: Research project using LSTM Neural Networks to predict Mexican Stock Market prices.
details: Used Long-Short Term Memory Neural Network to predict the Mexican Stock Market with chaotic behavior. Used Tensorflow for model building and different hyperparameter options to see the best results. Applied a post-prediction algorithm for the data which improves the similarity of the predicted data with the real data.

title: Tech Companies Stock Prices Forecast
description: CS50's final project using LSTM Neural Networks to forecast Apple, Tesla, Google, and Microsoft stock prices.
details: Trained LSTM Neural Network with Tensorflow to predict the stock prices of Apple, Tesla, Google, and Microsoft. Made with Python OOP.

title: Multivariate Polynomial Regression & Optimization
description: Implementation of model architecture, loss function, and optimization algorithms from scratch.
details: Implemented Multivariate Polynomial Regression and classification models from scratch. Implemented Adaptative Gradient Descent and Levenberg-Marquardt optimization algorithms, regularization, evaluation metrics for both models, prediction data visualization. Made with Python OOP.

title: Space Invaders Game
description: Two-player space invaders video game built with SDL2 and C++.
details: Implemented Collisions, Movements, and Game Logic. Two player mode. Made with SDL2 and C++.

title: SpaceX Launch Data Analysis
description: Data science project analyzing SpaceX launch data with comprehensive data collection, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and prediction.
details: Data Collection, Data Cleaning, Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Model Building and Prediction. Python. Comprehensive report included.
